title: DSH Superagent: Two-Layer Deterministic Gate, Follow-Up Ownership & Mandates
summary: Authorization separates a deterministic admission gate (explicit|inferred|ignore via sender-scope matrix and bot list) from LLM assessment. Subscribed-thread human follow-ups belong exclusively to the Ticket's Executor within its Mandate scope; Main Session may only stop.
